title: The Light Fantastic
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: The second Discworld novel follows a cowardly failed wizard and a cheerful tourist as the flat world faces a mysterious red star heading toward it. It picks up straight after the first book but works as a fresh comic fantasy.
readIf: you like silly, quick-fire fantasy parody and want the Discworld at its most joke-dense.
skipIf: you would rather read the first book before this direct continuation, or want a tightly plotted story.

pairings.reason: Same absurd, quotable humour pointed at science fiction instead of fantasy.
Pratchett again, this time with Neil Gaiman, with an apocalypse treated as a comic mishap.
Another fantasy that loves the genre while teasing it, with dry narration and sharp one-liners.
